name: guests
title: The page's standalone decision guests
purpose: Every proved decision the page's Node suites run without the holo, as the core wasm prismpm builds from the very modules the Prism compiles. Each guest is pinned by SHA-256 where the page opens it, and locked to the digest of the modules it was built from, so a guest older than its modules fails GU-01, and so does a guest whose wasm, opened as the page opens it, does not give every acceptance vector its answer. Each guest is one file, app/specs/guests/<facet>/<id>.json, with its lock beside it as <id>.lock.json, so two guests never meet in one file.
